ideas.pitch: An AI-powered training platform for nursing and medical students featuring an interactive patient simulator and real-time CPR posture feedback.
ideas.title: ArogyaSim: Interactive Clinical Case Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner by combining LLM-driven medical interviews with computer-vision pose tracking, demonstrating genuinely hard engineering that immediately catches judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: A gamified mobile application that verifies eco-friendly student behaviors on campus and rewards them with redeemable cafeteria perks.
ideas.title: EcoAction Campus: Sustainable Habit Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on clear, measurable environmental impact on a college campus, adopting the proven engagement loop of successful sustainability hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: A localized web forecasting tool that uses historical water metrics and machine learning to predict water contamination risks for local water bodies.
ideas.title: AquaPredict: Regional Algal Bloom Risk Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers concrete, quantifiable predictive insights that judges love, following the architecture of top-placed environmental data hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An accessible web platform designed to screen for dyslexia indicators and dynamically reformat text layouts with customized fonts and audio-visual support.
ideas.title: DyslexiaEase: Multi-Sensory Reading Support Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an underserved demographic with high social impact, matching the empathetic utility and problem-focused nature of past winning tools.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight desktop utility that monitors study fatigue through webcam attention indicators and enforces mandatory stretch and eye-rest breaks.
ideas.title: MicroBreak Study Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical student utility with a live-working computer vision demonstration that ensures an engaging and bulletproof 3-minute presentation.
